Self-hosted third-party files (no build step, no CDN).

three/            three.js r170, MIT licence (see three/LICENSE and three/README.txt).
k-glyphs.json     Outlines of the single letter K, extracted from these OFL-1.1 fonts (via Fontsource 5.3.0):
                  Archivo Black (Omnibus-Type), Anton (Vernon Adams), Playfair Display (Claus Eggers Sørensen),
                  Newsreader (Production Type), Instrument Serif (Instrument), Unbounded (NaN), DM Mono (Colophon).
                  SIL Open Font License 1.1: https://openfontlicense.org
